To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

random synaptic feedback weights can support error backpropgation in deep networks, and this is important because it shows that the strong architectural constraints of backpropagation are not necessary for deep learning.
(1) a random synaptic connectivity pattern can propagate error signals in deep learning architectures and (2) this propagation mechanism is as effective as backpropagation.
(i) random feedback weights can support error backpropgation for deep learning; and (ii) this mechanism can transmit teaching signal across multiple layers of artificial neurons.
